d:
Bihar ki rajniti men in dinon 'nitish setu' ke nam ko lekar naya vivad chhir gaya hai. mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne kachchi dargah-bidupur siks len pul ka nam purv mukhyamantri nitish kumar ke nam par 'nitish setu' rakhne ka prastav rakha. lekin is phaisle ke bad RJD ne saval khare kar die hain.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
